newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel drops 10.42 percent in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Piltel drops 10.42 percent in Manila.

text.p: Pilipino Telephone Corp lost 2.50 pesos, or 10.42 percent, to 21.50 pesos by midtrade in Manila on foreign selling, brokers said.
"A foreign brokerage is selling the issue on talk the firm may book weak earnings in the first nine months of the year because of losses from cloning," said one local trader.
An official of the country's largest cellular phone company told Reuters Piltel posted a 27 percent increase in net income in the first nine months of the year to 722.4 million pesos.
Some 5.963 million Piltel shares changed hands after nearly two hours of trading at the Philippine Stock Exchange.
